# dbdiagramr

> dbdiagramr is a free, open-source web tool that generates interactive entity-relationship (ER) diagrams from any PostgreSQL connection string. No signup, no setup - paste your connection string and visualize your database schema in under 10 seconds.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.dbdiagramr.space): PostgreSQL ER diagram tool with paste-SQL and live connection modes.
- [Visualize your database](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/visualize): Interactive diagram canvas for pasted SQL or a live PostgreSQL connection string.
- [Schema diagram library](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema): Reference ER diagrams for popular PostgreSQL schemas.
- [Blog](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/blog): PostgreSQL and database schema guides.
- [Comparisons](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/alternatives): How dbdiagramr compares with other diagram tools.
- [Supabase RLS check](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/supabase-rls-check): Check Row Level Security status for a Supabase schema.
- [Pricing](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/pricing): Free plan and planned Pro features.
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/pricing.md): Pricing details for automated agents.
- [Full context](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/llms-full.txt): Extended product and feature context.
- [Features](https://www.dbdiagramr.space#features): Interactive canvas, hover tracing, and export features.
- [How it works](https://www.dbdiagramr.space#guide): Steps for generating a PostgreSQL ER diagram.

## Schema diagram library

- [Supabase auth schema](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/supabase): 7 tables from Supabase's built-in auth schema.
- [NextAuth.js / Auth.js schema](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/nextauth): 4 tables for NextAuth.js and Auth.js.
- [Better Auth schema](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/better-auth): 4 tables for Better Auth.
- [Laravel 11 default schema](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/laravel): 7 tables from the Laravel 11 default schema.
- [Django auth schema](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/django): 9 tables from Django's auth schema.
- [Stripe billing schema](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/stripe): 9 tables for a Stripe-style billing model.
- [E-commerce schema](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/schema/ecommerce): 11 tables for an e-commerce application.

## Pricing

- [Free plan](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/pricing): $0 with unlimited diagrams, live PostgreSQL introspection, per-table RLS status, paste-SQL mode, SVG and PNG export, and no signup.
- [Pro plan](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/pricing): In development with no price or checkout. Planned features include schema checks on private-repo pull requests, lint rules for risky migrations, and sticky PR comments.

## About

- [Source code](https://github.com/VarunKvK/dbdiagramr): Open source under the MIT licence.
- [Contact and updates](https://x.com/im_daedalus): Follow dbdiagramr on X.
- [Full context](https://www.dbdiagramr.space/llms-full.txt): Free with no diagram limit and no account; interactive ER diagrams from live PostgreSQL schemas; pan, zoom, and hover-to-trace relationships; SVG and PNG export; per-table RLS status on live connections; support for Supabase, Neon, Railway, the Session pooler (5432), and the Transaction pooler (6543); paste-SQL parsing in the browser; live connection strings sent to the backend for one request and then discarded; no stored connection strings or schemas; built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Tailwind CSS.

Last updated: 2026-10-23
